help_furniture-serverrack_content:
**Server infrastructure** is required for IT Services offices.

**Blade Server — $2,500** ($40/day power & connectivity)
* Minimum for **IT Support Desk** offices (about 1 per 150 m², max 8)
* Rack or mainframe servers also satisfy IT Support requirements

**Rack Server — $5,000** ($80/day power & connectivity)
* Minimum for **Software Development Agency** offices (about 1 per 75 m², max 20)
* Mainframe servers also satisfy Software Dev requirements

**Mainframe Server — $35,000** ($160/day power & connectivity)
* Used by **Cloud Services Office** alongside other server types
* Cloud offices need a mix of all three server types
* About 1 server (any type) per 25 m² (max 50 total)
* Cloud hourly fee is a **flat tier rate** based on your best installed server: blade **$210**, rack **$360**, mainframe **$600**. More servers satisfy requirements but do not stack the hourly fee. Scale revenue with more programmers on shift, not by raising the fee far above your tier rate (customers reject prices much above market).

**Flat service fees (IT Support & Software Dev):**
* IT Support hourly fee stays **$138** regardless of server type
* Software Development hourly fee stays **$239** regardless of server type

**Competition:** Rival IT offices can open in neighborhoods over time. They set competitive hourly rates, so traffic drops if you charge far above the local market. You can buy out rival IT offices like other businesses once you meet the diploma requirements.

Available from:
* Factory Supply Depot
* Essentials Appliances
